Try ituse_sim_time, with and without the file

Gazebo publishes its own time on /clock (see Simulation Time above). With use_sim_time true, a node's clock follows it instead of the computer's clock: now() returns the simulation's time, so every geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped stamp shows it too. try it

Every node has use_sim_time, false unless you set it. How was the node started?




  
Set it for every node that runs with GazeboSet use_sim_time to true for every node you run with Gazebo. The /** key of a parameter file does it for all of them.
